sentence: Drink more water because it's good for our hair and skin.
synonym: it helps our hair and skin
synonymNote: 两者都表示对头发和皮肤有益，意思相同

distractors.word: it's bad for our hair and skin
distractors.note: 意思相反，表示有害而非有益

distractors.word: it cleans our hair and skin
distractors.note: 只说清洁，不等于整体有益
意思不完整，忽略了皮肤的部分
